name: The Shattered Mountain Weeps
text:
A massive sphere of rock explodes, unleashing a cataclysm of falling debris and deadly shrapnel. Its destruction falls in a 20-foot burst within 120 feet. Creatures in the area take ternary(gte(@actor.level,20,10,9))d10 bludgeoning damage with a basic Fortitude save save against your class DC. Those who fail are knocked Prone. For the next minute, rocks continue to fall, making the area difficult terrain and dealing ternary(gte(@actor.level,20,4,3))d10 bludgeoning damage to any creature that ends its turn in the area. If you use this impulse again, any previous one ends.

---
Level (20th) The initial damage is 10d10, and the area damage is 4d10.
